about_the_game:
Do you love fast-paced kart racing, preferably with family and friends? Have you already raced through the tracks of GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions with Ed & Edda, are you longing for more, and are you a fan of Europa-Park? Then we have just the expansion you've been waiting for!

Because ‘Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Goes Europa-Park’ allows you to race through Europa-Park itself at high speed!

  • Four brand new tracks at Europa-Park – drive them individually in different modes or one after the other in the Grand Prix!

  • Race tracks inspired by the layout of Europa-Park for a real park feeling!

  • Drive through many of the park's themed areas, racing past Voltron Nevera, Wodan Timburcoaster or the Eurosat sphere!

  • Race through the famous entrance gate of Europa-Park or venture into the Swiss bobsleigh track with your racer!

  • Brand new racing mode: Prove that you are faster than the legendary ‘blue fire Megacoaster’ in the roller coaster challenge – alone or with up to four players in local multiplayer mode!

  • 4 new characters with their own racers and designs – race through all the new and old tracks as Snorri, the star of Rulantica, Mme Freudenreich, the hero of DINO MATES, Sock the Allosaurus or the Yomi Rubi!
